workshopHint: No customer or vehicle selected: this is a general workshop reminder.

import.title: Import reminders
import.description: Upload a CSV or Excel file with one reminder per row. You will see every row before anything is saved.
import.drop: Drop a CSV or Excel file here
import.formats: CSV or Excel (.xlsx), up to {rows} rows
import.templateHint: Start from the template to get the columns right.

columns.title: What needs doing, for example "Oil change".
columns.dueDate: The day it is due. 2026-10-15 always works, and formats like 15.10.2026 or 10/15/2026 are detected.
columns.dueTime: Time of day, for example 14:30, in the workshop's time zone. Leave it empty for any time that day.
columns.dueMileage: The odometer reading it is due at, in {unit}.
columns.licensePlate: Links the reminder to a vehicle. Spaces and dashes are ignored.
columns.vin: Links the reminder to a vehicle, useful when there is no plate.
columns.customer: Email, customer number or exact name. Used only when the row has no vehicle.
columns.emailNotification: Yes or no. Sends an email when the reminder is due. In-app notifications are always on.

import.targetRule: A row with no vehicle and no customer becomes a workshop reminder. Rows that match an open reminder are skipped, so uploading the same file twice adds nothing.

issues.missingDue: Needs a due date or a due mileage.
issues.timeWithoutDate: A time needs a due date.
issues.badEmailNotification: Email notification should be yes or no, not "{value}".
issues.vehicleMismatch: The plate and the VIN belong to different vehicles ({value}).
issues.customerAmbiguous: More than one customer matches "{value}". Use their email or customer number.
issues.duplicateInFile: Skipped: repeats an earlier row in the file.

fileErrors.demo: Importing is turned off on the demo.
fileErrors.tooLarge: The file is larger than 900 KB. Split it and import it in parts.
fileErrors.legacyXls: Old Excel .xls files can't be read. Save the file as .xlsx or .csv and try again.
fileErrors.unreadable: The file could not be read.
fileErrors.tooManyRows: The file has more than {limit} rows. Split it and import it in parts.
fileErrors.noTitleColumn: The file has no Title column. Download the template to see the headers it expects.

import.submit: Import {count, plural, one {# reminder} other {# reminders}}
import.done: {count, plural, one {# reminder imported} other {# reminders imported}}
import.doneSkipped: {count, plural, one {# row skipped} other {# rows skipped}}
